kind: analyze, implement-from-equations (extended AGF / mode-resolved S-matrix of the Si/Ge device from staged harmonic force-constant blocks; channel counts, total transmission, mean and spread of the mode-resolved transmission at nine frequencies)
provenance: 3_reproduction/L3/out_tersoff/agent_unit_answer.json (commit eac8a5c; the nine-frequency unit solved from the frozen fc_device.hdf5 with the leaf's certified AGF code at eta/omega_max^2 = 1e-12; five of the nine agree digit for digit with the metric table of result.json, reviewer ruling 2026-09-06 makes case B the ground truth), re-solved from the staged trimmed file on workstation by reviewer/verify_on_desktop.sh on 2026-09-10 (reference_submission/answer.json, reference_diagnostics.json). std_tau_Si from the same case-B S-matrix (reviewer/std_tau_from_caseB.json) and from the staged-file solve (identical).
